title: ExecutionProvider
description: A governed execution provider declaration. Binds a provider (e.g. agent-machine) to its governance posture: trust tier, agent-class scope, and the activation prerequisites that must be satisfied before it may run. A provider MUST list at least one AttestationDecision URN (urn:srcos:agent-machine:attestation-decision:*) as an activation prerequisite — attestation is a precondition for activation (agent-machine T2-1).

activation_prerequisites.description: URN references that must be satisfied before activation. MUST contain at least one AttestationDecision URN.

agent_class_scope.description: Which agent classes this provider may execute (AgentPassport five-class model).
